claims.originalText: Art Institute of Chicago catalogues this object as "Bell (nao)".

館方著錄年代為西周（公元前 1046–771 年）。

claims.originalText: This catalogue material designation describes the recorded museum object; it is not a laboratory identification or an authentication of an unexamined collector object.

claims.originalText: This bell was designed to be mounted on its hollow stem with its curved mouth facing up and struck from the outside with a mallet. Unlike other types of bronze bells that were assembled as chime sets, this one was intended to be played as an individual instrument.

qualifiers.editorialScope: Attributed catalogue evidence; no independent authentication is implied.

variants.text: This bell was designed to be mounted on its hollow stem with its curved mouth facing up and struck from the outside with a mallet. Unlike other types of bronze bells that were assembled as chime sets, this one was intended to be played as an individual instrument.
此鐘原設計為以中空柄安置，弧形鐘口向上，用槌敲擊外側。它與編組成套的其他青銅鐘不同，原作單件樂器演奏。

claims.originalText: Art Institute of Chicago records "China, probably Hunan province"; the provincial attribution remains qualified rather than a confirmed excavation location.
